vpcs.description: Configuration parameters for the Virtual PC Simulator (vpcs) service.

vpcs.num_instances.description: Number of virtual PC instances to start (default is 9). Corresponds to the -i option.

vpcs.listen_port.description: Base UDP port number that vpcs uses to listen for messages (default is 20000). Corresponds to the -s option.

vpcs.send_port.description: Base UDP port number that vpcs streams packets to (default is 30000). Corresponds to the -c option.

vpcs.send_host.description: IPv4 address to stream packets to (default is 127.0.0.1). Corresponds to the -t option.

vpcs.mac_offset.description: Value added to the last byte of the base MAC address to avoid clashes. Corresponds to the -m option.

vpcs.script_file.description: Path to a vpcs script file to be read and executed on start-up. Corresponds to the scriptfile argument.

vpcs.daemon_port.description: TCP port for vpcs to run as a daemon process. If empty, daemon mode is disabled. Corresponds to the -p option.

vpcs.tap_mode.description: If true, run vpcs in TAP mode using /dev/tapx interfaces instead of UDP. Corresponds to the -e option.

vpcs.tap_device.description: Device name for TAP mode, used only when num_instances is 1. Corresponds to the -d option.

vpcs.hypervisor_port.description: TCP port for vpcs to run as a hypervisor. If empty, hypervisor mode is disabled. Corresponds to the -H option.
